title: the Kuiper Line Rising Revisited
author: Wendell Amberdale
blurb: Sebastian Okonkwo, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
